notes.title: Shoppe Keep 2 Character Creator Preview Is Now Live
notes.content:
Hello Keepers!

Welcome to the launch of the Shoppe Keep 2 Character Creator Preview! A free app which will allow you to experience the joys of some of the character customization available in Shoppe Keep 2! But let's be real honest, this is merely a clever marketing ruse which allows us to share the game with new players! (SHHHHHH!)

The customization options are pretty limited and in no way represent the quality or number of customization options that will be available when Shoppe Keep 2 launches.This is after all just a preview. 

Expect at least minutes of enjoyment* as you dress up your Keeper in various items of clothing and socks. Yes that's right! Socks! 

Or if you prefer, allow your Keeper to feel the wind brush over their unmentionables, standing as naked as the day they were born.

If you download this app and then play Shoppe Keep 2, you'll be given a special Golden Keeper outfit for use in Shoppe Keep 2. Want to see what it looks like - well here it is (along with a brand new dancing Emote):

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31841452/8e9185e6bf99cc003c0a1956265f228943da6d32.gif[/img]

So there we have it! Download it now! It's free and is sure to kill at least a few minutes! Go on! Make sure to share your creations on Twitter! Why? Because you'll be entered into a competition to win a real world model based on the keeper that you created! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31841452/7f12e149f0e6e25a08a36063d432879ab08583aa.png[/img]

If this post, the character creator or even the name itself has piqued your interest (good job marketing team), why not head over to the Shoppe Keep 2 page, watch some video, check out the screenshots, maybe even join in on the community forums and add the game to your wish list.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/684580/Shoppe_Keep_2/

*Estimated length of playtime was based on my mate Dave's experience
